title: Is MT3UK free to join?
description: Yes, it's a free Facebook group. No membership fees, no sign-up forms, just an admin-approved request to keep the bots and spam out.

title: Which Tesla models can I bring?
description: All of them. Model S, 3, X and Y owners are all welcome, whatever stage your build is at.

title: Do I need to already have mods to join?
description: No. Plenty of members join a stock Tesla looking for advice before they fit their first set of wheels or a wrap.

title: How do I get my build featured in the gallery?
description: Submit a photo and caption using the form in the gallery section, or post it in the Facebook group and an admin will add it for you.

title: Is there a track day for first timers?
description: Yes, we're gauging interest for a group track session. Check the events section above or ask in the Facebook group.
